top_signals.title: Waterborne shipments from the U.S. Gulf Coast increased in April and May
top_signals.summary: Waterborne shipments of crude oil and petroleum products from the U.S. Gulf Coast (PADD 3) to the West Coast (PADD 5) more than quadrupled year-on-year in April and May following a waiver that permitted a broader group of ships to travel between U.S. ports. Shipments from the U.S. Gulf Coast to the East Coast (PADD 1) also increased.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: More European Savers Should Be Investing: JPMorgan
top_signals.summary: Savers across Europe and the UK could be getting a better return on their money if they put more of their cash savings into investment accounts says Patrick Thomson, EMEA CEO of JPMorgan Asset Management. This is particularly important given Europe has an ageing population, so citizens will need pensions that last for longer. Thomson spoke to Bloomberg's Francine Lacqua on 'The Pulse'. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Pakistan’s Energy Crisis Set to Ease as Qatari LNG Breaks Through Hormuz
top_signals.summary: Pakistan is about to get some energy relief with tankers carrying Qatari LNG set to arrive in the country this month. The first cargo is seen arriving as early as Thursday, Bloomberg reported, citing ship-tracking data. Pakistan has been struggling to keep the lights on after Qatar declared force majeure on its exports following Iranian strikes that caused damage to its Ras Laffan LNG hub.
